title: AI capability is accelerating, adoption at an unprecedented pace, outpacing education
description: THE NINTH AI Index Report, released by the Stanford Institute for Human-Centered Artificial Intelligence (HAI), centers on a key research question: Can AI-based systems keep pace with the rapid advancement of artificial intelligence? The report tracks AI development across areas such as reasoning, real-world task execution and safety. It also presents updated estimates of generative AI’s economic value and its impact on the labor market.
